**Test build for Nexo 1.2**: the **Emulator** plugin, so friends on test builds can try playing console games
together before everyone gets it. The Retro games from test.1 are gone. Everyone else stays on v1.1.0.

> **Hosts:** this needs the server from this test build too. Until the server runs it, turning the
> Emulator on in **Settings → Plugins** fails with "Unknown plugin". After that, an admin turns it on (it's
> off by default).

## Emulator

Play SNES games you own, together.

- **Host:** in a voice channel, click the **controller** button in the voice toolbar and pick a game file
  from your computer (`.sfc`, `.smc`, `.swc`, `.fig` or `.zip`). Nexo runs it and streams it to the call, and you're player 1.
  You get **Pause**, **Reset**, **Quick save / load** and your own volume.
- **Play along:** friends in the call click **Take** on controller 2–4 and play with their own keyboard or
  an Xbox-style controller (press a button once so Nexo sees it). Four players work in games that support
  the SNES multitap.
- **Watch:** everyone else in the channel sees the game on the stage. **Hide** (or the controller button)
  switches back to the people.

The file stays on your computer; only its name is shown to the others. Nexo doesn't provide games.

## What to test

- **Host:** does your game run at full speed with sound?
- **Players:** can friends take controllers 2–4 and play? How much delay do they notice?
- **Stream:** is the picture sharp and smooth for the people watching?
- **Controllers:** do Xbox-style controllers work right away?

## Leaving test builds

Already on a test build? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself. To go back to the regular releases:
**Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
